parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters), one per logical submit. A repeat of the same request (method, path, body) with the same key within 24 hours returns the first response (status and body, header Idempotency-Replayed: true) when that response is final for the request: a 2xx, or a refusal that is a function of the request alone. A refusal that depends on state another request can change is not stored and the key is released, so a retry under the same key runs again (with another body it is a new request). These problem types are not stored and release the key: concurrent-update, departure-closed, departure-full, illegal-transition, lane-closed, not-found, package-already-loaded. A server failure (5xx) is never stored. While a key holds a stored answer, the same key with another request is 409 idempotency-key-reused.
